def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    scores[valid] = -np.exp(rem[valid] / max_cap) - np.log(1.0 + rem[valid])
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    scores[is_empty] += 0.5
    return scores

    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)

    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0

        scores[first_empty] = np.min(scores[valid]) - 1.0
    return scores

    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    initial_cap = bins[valid]
    used_ratio = 1.0 - (rem[valid] / (initial_cap + 1e-8))
    scores[valid] = np.exp(-rem[valid] / max_cap) + 1.5 * used_ratio
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        scores[empty_mask] += 0.5
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    target = 0.1 * max_cap
    scores[valid] = np.exp(-np.abs(rem[valid] - target) / (max_cap + 1e-8))
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[first_empty] -= 0.15
    return scores
